ranked.headline: Multimodal deep learning for drug synergy and drug-target interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent 2025 work pairs fusion, rebalancing, and few-shot adaptation with evaluation frameworks that test whether synergy models generalize across data splits.

ranked.headline: Single-cell methods infer regulatory networks, kinetics, and programs from noisy data
ranked.summary: Recent single-cell methods pair regulatory inference with calibration, identifiability, or prior-knowledge constraints.

ranked.headline: Graph and kernel models integrate multi-omics and imaging data for cancer prediction
ranked.summary: Recent models explicitly capture feature-level interactions, missing modalities and spatial context for patient stratification.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings fused with structure and task-specific networks
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs pretrained protein language model embeddings with structure graphs, retrieval, and interpretable networks for diverse prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Computational inference from sequencing data that accounts for technical noise and bias
ranked.summary: Nanopore, single-cell, and RNA-seq tools now model noise, dropout, and sequence bias directly, with new benchmarks for m6A detection and splicing analysis.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict methylation, TF binding and regulatory variant effects
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence representations and attention architectures now extend regulatory prediction to personalized genomes, long reads, and farmed animals.

ranked.headline: Reference-anchored tools for variant calling, CNV inference and pangenome browsing
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks of variant callers and T2T-CHM13 mapping test how reference choice shapes variant detection in WGS and long-read data.

ranked.headline: Spatiotemporal models infer cell fate and niche paths from spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Multi-timepoint spatial slides now support explicit joint modeling of tissue position and temporal ordering during trajectory inference.

ranked.headline: Attention and pretrained networks predict diverse RNA functions and modification sites
ranked.summary: November 2025 work pairs pretrained RNA and gene language models with attention networks across ncRNA, lncRNA, and modification tasks.

ranked.headline: Reproducible pipelines integrate QC, assembly, and taxonomy for metagenomic and NGS data
ranked.summary: Recent releases package sequence analyses as reproducible, containerized workflows spanning QC, assembly, taxonomy, and statistical interpretation.

ranked.headline: Generative sequence models designing antigen-facing immune and antimicrobial molecules
ranked.summary: Generative models now target antibody, TCR, neoantigen and antimicrobial peptide design with explicit objectives in recent 2025 publications.

ranked.headline: Inference recovers structure from sparse, static, or partially labeled measurements
ranked.summary: Several November 2025 publications and a preprint apply computational inference to static, sparse, or unlabeled single-cell and imaging measurements.

ranked.headline: Graph and diffusion models couple transcriptomic expression with spatial structure
ranked.summary: Recent published and preprint work extends graph and generative models to spatial and single-cell transcriptomic integration, prediction, and enhancement.

ranked.headline: New statistical methods refine epistasis, TWAS, QTL and polygenic risk analysis
ranked.summary: Single-cell eQTLs, GWAS follow-up platforms and knockoff-based variable selection are extending association testing to finer resolution.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for nucleic acid structure, ligand kinetics, and sequence fitness
ranked.summary: New benchmarks and blind CASP16 tests now evaluate nucleic acid models against experimental assays and cryo-EM density.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict protein binding while benchmarks expose ΔΔG and pose limits
ranked.summary: Structure-aware graph networks and AlphaFold refinements now target affinity and complex geometry, alongside new third-party benchmarks of their accuracy.

ranked.headline: Specialized tools target genomic interval tokenization, metadata curation and SV analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe purpose-built software for genomic data representation, curation, imputation, and structural variant analysis.

ranked.headline: Packaged bioinformatics methods target reproducibility, interactivity and efficiency
ranked.summary: Recent published and preprint tools make magnetic tweezers, single-cell, breeding and metabolic modeling workflows runnable as open software.

ranked.headline: Homology networks and benchmarks reveal bacterial mobile DNA exchange and detection
ranked.summary: Short-read and genome-collection tools now enable large-scale profiling of plasmids, prophages and mobile elements across bacterial populations.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks predict microbial, drug-target and gene-drug associations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply graph neural networks to sparse microbial, drug and phage-host interaction data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models map disorder, phase separation and dark kinase associations
ranked.summary: Transformer, LSTM and protein language model approaches now scale predictions across kinomes, condensates and PubMed-derived regulatory networks.

ranked.headline: Transposable elements and methylation plasticity shape eukaryotic genome variation
ranked.summary: Long-read methylome tools and population-scale WGBS now resolve temperature-driven and tissue-specific epigenomic variation.

ranked.headline: Graph and deep networks integrate omics data for prediction and interaction inference
ranked.summary: Network architectures are being applied to multi-omics integration, missing-data recovery, and ligand-receptor inference across recent 2025 publications.

ranked.headline: Open software tools integrate multi-omics data via joint interaction networks
ranked.summary: Web servers and R packages now enable network-based multi-omics integration as reproducible workflows for expert users.

ranked.headline: AlphaFold-derived models and ML tools extend structure-centric biomolecular analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool apply AlphaFold outputs and deep learning to domain, variant, genome, and crystal analysis.

ranked.headline: Fusion, uncertainty, and robustness to limited data in supervised biomedical classifiers
ranked.summary: Recent studies couple biomedical predictors with uncertainty estimation, multimodal fusion, and tolerance of missing or small datasets.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for peptide modification prediction and PTM co-occurrence
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs structure-aware retention prediction, lactylation site prediction, and coexisting PTM isoform identification from tandem MS spectra.

ranked.headline: LLMs and semantic mapping are structuring bioinformatics workflows and identifiers
ranked.summary: LLM-based retrieval now recovers full analysis workflows from publications, alongside provenance-tracked identifier mapping across ontologies.

ranked.headline: Scaling core sequence analysis methods for memory, speed, and read-scale workloads
ranked.summary: Read sets of 89M reads and large-scale or real-time motif comparison make memory and runtime limits central to these tools.

ranked.headline: Relatedness-aware methods refine SNP effect inference and fine-mapping in GWAS
ranked.summary: Association inference in related individuals and EHR-derived phenotypes now requires explicit modeling of genetic relatedness.

ranked.headline: Systems models link neural network, metabolic, and genetic architecture to disease
ranked.summary: Systems-level models are beginning to tie causal brain connectivity, neuronal metabolism, and callosal genetics to neurodegeneration.

ranked.headline: Learned models refine pathogenic variant interpretation across rare disease genomics
ranked.summary: Whole-genome data from 12,568 rare-disease families and new variant classifiers sharpen how pathogenic variants are identified and prioritized.

ranked.headline: Integrating gene networks and explainable ML to nominate repurposed drugs
ranked.summary: Repurposing efforts now pair transcriptomic meta-analysis, explainable ML and gene regulatory networks with drug-target resources to prioritize candidates.

ranked.headline: Phylogeny-aware GO enrichment and community curation of biosynthetic gene databases
ranked.summary: Growing datasets across diverse species make phylogenetically informed enrichment and scalable community curation relevant now.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level assemblies of an annelid, a cricket, and a tachinid parasitoid
ranked.summary: Three November 2025 preprints report genome assemblies for an annelid, a cricket, and a tachinid parasitoid, with annotation and comparative resources.

ranked.headline: Generative and ligand-based design methods are being evaluated against docking
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks ligand-based screening against docking and introduces linker-focused generative design for MsbA inhibitors.
